title: map_board_load traps (runtime panic) instead of returning its error for missing/mistyped terrain or streets JSON keys, bypassing the app's defined fallback
detail: Missing or mistyped terrain/streets keys trap at runtime instead of returning the defined error, so the app's graceful fallback-to-procedural (and the harness's fail-loud error print) never runs; a corrupt asset aborts boot.
recommended_fix: Use the comma-ok form for the terrain/streets lookups (like board/districts/spawn_candidates) and return the defined error string on a missing or mistyped block; never trap.
